judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete, having stopped mid-way through its own Definition of Done. While it adds `ajv` to `package.json` and compiles the schema in `ToolRegistry.register`, it never actually modifies `ToolRegistry.execute` to call the validator or handle dynamic function-valued tool schemas via a `WeakMap`. Consequently, 3 out of the 4 tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Furthermore, it misses almost all the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the JSDoc comment on `execute`, and the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`.
